summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: (1) botocore/regions.py: added `from enum import Enum` and appended the str-valued EndpointResolverBuiltins enum with the eleven members, values, and comments from the spec. (2) botocore/args.py: imported the enum as EPRBuiltins; made _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept a None endpoint config (treated as no variant tags); added public compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults to ClientArgsCreator after _ensure_boolean. It reuses the bridge's use_fips_endpoint variant lookup, the bridge's DualStack lookup, and the existing S3 and STS predicates. SDK_ENDPOINT is kept as a key with value None when absent. (3) tests/unit/test_args.py: added TestEndpointResolverBuiltins (derived from unittest.TestCase) covering every behavioral criterion. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py (58 passed), plus test_client.py and test_regions.py (414 passed across the three modules). black and isort are not installed in the prepared venv, so formatting was checked by line-length scan and reading only. Nothing committed.
